Label.text: Views over models: they realise only the rows on screen, and follow the model when it changes. The models are native (a list, a table behind a sorting proxy, a tree).
Inserted rows land above what you see, which stays put. F2 renames a row; a double-click or Return activates it; drag a row to move it.
Click a row, or focus the list and use the arrows.
Rows from a markup template, each its own height

ListView.items: A short row|A row with rather more to say, so that it wraps onto a second line in a list this narrow|Short again|Rows are measured as they come into view: the scroll bar settles as you go, and what is on screen never jumps|One more|And a last row, long enough to wrap onto a second line as well

Label.text: A ListView in markup: each row is a template filled from its item and its index. Ctrl and Shift select several; Ctrl+A all; drag them to reorder.
A grid: the same view, laid out in cells
The arrows move across and down; type a letter to jump to a tree.
TableView: click a header to sort
Drag a header's right edge to resize its column; the selection follows its row when it sorts. F2 edits a name.
TreeView: click the arrows, or use the arrow keys; drag nodes onto or beside others
